item.title: Replacing Protobuf with Rust to go 5 times faster
item.description:
📝 Protobuf is fast, but not using Protobuf is faster. rs is a Rust wrapper around libpg_query which uses Protobuf for (de)serialization. Replace Protobuf with bindgen-generated Rust structs that map directly to the Postgres AST.
🔗 Read more: https://pgdog.dev/blog/replace-protobuf-with-rust

item.title: The State of Modern AI Text to Speech Systems for Screen Reader Users
item.description:
📝 The needs of a blind text to speech user are vastly different than those of a sighted user. While sighted users prefer voices that are natural, conversational, and as human-like as possible, blind users tend to prefer voices that are fast, clear, predictable, and efficient. As most modern text to speech voices are created by and for sighted users, blind users begin to find that the voices available in less popular languages are inefficient, overly conversational, slow, and otherwise unsatisfactory.
🔗 Read more: https://stuff.interfree.ca/2026/01/05/ai-tts-for-screenreaders.html
